description: LocalStack log analyzer that helps developers quickly diagnose issues and understand their LocalStack interactions

analysisType.description: The analysis to perform: 'summary' (default), 'errors', 'requests', or 'logs' for raw output.

filter.description: Raw keyword filter. Only used with 'logs' mode.

lines.description: Number of recent log lines to fetch and analyze.

operation.description: Filter by a specific API operation (e.g., 'CreateBucket'). Requires 'service'. Used with 'requests' mode.

service.description: Filter by AWS service (e.g., 's3', 'lambda'). Used with 'errors' and 'requests' modes.

name: localstack-logs-analysis
title: LocalStack Logs Analysis
